'Eleceed' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, First Promo
The official website for the Eleceed television anime revealed the main cast, additional staff, and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime adapting Jae-Ho Son and ZHENA's super power action webtoon is scheduled to premiere in 2027. 'Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen' Announces Additional Cast
The official website for the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen (Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc) television anime revealed additional cast members and a character visual (pictured above) on Thursday. 'Koori no Jouheki' Gets Second Season in Fall 2026
The 14th and final episode of Koori no Jouheki (The Ramparts of Ice) ended with an announcement on Friday that a second season is in production. The official website also revealed a teaser visual (pictured). The second season is scheduled to premiere on October 1 at 11:56 p.m. on TBS' 28 affiliated stations. Short Story 'Rusuban' Gets Short Anime Movie for August 2026
Animation studio Rock'n Roll Mountain announced a short anime movie adaptation of Akiko Okuda's Rusuban (Babysitting) short manga story on Thursday, revealing the cast, staff, a visual (pictured), and a trailer. The movie is scheduled to open on August 1 at K's cinema in Shinjuku for a one-week limited theatrical run. Cast Cocoha Tachibana Yuka Katou (Kimi no Na wa.) Yoshitaka Amano's Original Anime 'Zan' in Production
Yoshitaka Amano's newest company, Yoshitaka Amano Inc., announced on Thursday that the previously announced Zan anime project is in production and revealed the main staff. The pilot will be shown at the Anime Expo 2026 convention on July 3.
